uspContent.title: Why you should work with me
uspContent.chatAriaLabel: Chat between a client and Moritz

messages.author: visitor
questionEmphasis: Why should I work with you specifically?
messages.text: Okay Moritz, I recognize myself in that. But there are plenty of web designers. Why should I work with you specifically?

messages.author: owner
highlights: web design with real software development
messages.text: I combine web design with real software development. I've worked with code for 10 years, including 3 years professionally and for the past year, my focus has been web design.

messages.author: visitor
messages.text: And what does that mean for my website?

messages.author: owner
messages.text: It's built with real code instead of a site builder. That means a custom design without fixed templates, fast load times, and a website we can expand as your business grows.

messages.author: visitor
messages.text: And do I always speak with you directly?

messages.author: owner
messages.text: Yes. You always speak directly with me, usually get a reply within 24 hours, and can still reach me after launch. I explain technical topics clearly and openly tell you what you don't need.

messages.author: visitor
messages.text: Sounds good. How do we figure out what makes sense for me?

messages.author: owner
highlights: free and comes with no obligation
messages.text: We'll discuss your plans in 15 minutes. Afterwards, I'll tell you honestly what makes sense and what to expect. The conversation is free and comes with no obligation.
